newsitem.title: USA: TU 1,150 MW plant seen at full power Fri.
newsitem.headline: TU 1,150 MW plant seen at full power Fri.

text.p: Texas Utilities Co's 1,150 megawatt Comanche Peak nuclear power plant 1 was likely to reach full production Friday following a scheduled maintenance outage, a company spokesman said Friday.
"Barring anything unforeseen, it should reach 100 percent later today," said spokesman Jim Lawrence.
The Glen Rose, Texas, unit was shut Oct 5 for refueling and maintenance. It resumed power production the weekend of Nov 17 and has been raising output during restart testing.
The adjacent 1,150 megawatt Comanche Peak nuclear power unit 2 was operating at full power.
